notes: Set reward_pulse_on_sec to the calibrated session_info['solenoid_blink_duration'] used by the working Go/NoGo box. Do not guess it. Reward is triggered at 1.0 s and the image always ends at 1.5 s; a longer calibrated train may continue into gray ITI but must finish before suction onset. Reward is open-loop and never lick-contingent. Reward probability is fixed at 0.90 in reward_conditioning_protocol.py and is intentionally not configurable here.
